Name: Karlyga Izbastina (née Tokayeva)
Current_Role: Businesswoman; co-founder, Kemel Tokayev Charitable Foundation
Notes: Wife of Temirtai Izbastin; mother of Dana Medeuova and Kanysh, Mukhamed and Beket Izbastin.

Name: Temirtai Izbastin
Notes: Full name Temirtai Rymtayevich Izbastin. Almaty State Medical Institute 1980; law, KazNPU 2008; Russian MFA Diplomatic Academy courses 1999; PhD, Sofia University 2015. Ambassadorship ended 9 Dec 2022, following the 2022 constitutional amendments on presidential relatives in political posts. Brother: Marat Izbastin.

Name: Timur (Tokayev) Kemel
Current_Role: Businessman; chairman, Kemel Tokayev Charitable Foundation
Notes: Only child of Kassym-Jomart and Nadezhda Tokayeva. Surname changed to Kemel (Kemell) in 2019. Based in Geneva. Educated at Collège du Léman, Webster University Geneva and the Russian MFA Diplomatic Academy (dissertation 2009). No government post.

Name: Dana Medeuova
Notes: Née Izbastina. Candidate of political science 2004; docent 2006. Elected to the Kurultai on the Adilet party list, Aug 2026. Children: Nurassyl Medeu and Nurai Medeuova.

Name: Kanysh Izbastin
Current_Role: Former First Deputy Chairman, Baiterek (left Jan 2022); current post unknown
School: Moscow State Institute of International Relations
Notes: Full name Kanysh Temirtayevich Izbastin. MGIMO and Central Asian University; PhD economics. Wife Botagoz Karbuzova; father-in-law Koza-Korpesh Karbuzov. Three minor children (not listed).

Name: Koza-Korpesh Karbuzov
Notes: Full name Koza-Korpesh Zhaparkhanovich Karbuzov. Law, Kazakh State University (now KazNU) 1981; finance, KazNU 2003. Major general (2000); candidate of legal sciences (2001). Order Dank, 2nd (2004) and 1st (2009) class. Not to be confused with Koza-Korpesh Dzhanburchin.

Name: Mukhamed Izbastin
Current_Role: President, Qazaq Cybersport Federation; businessman (TSM Group, 3I Materials)
School: Moscow State Institute of International Relations
Notes: Full name Mukhamed Temirtayevich Izbastin; cousin of Timur Kemel. MGIMO 2003; candidate of sciences, Russian MFA Diplomatic Academy, 2005. Forbes Kazakhstan 50 most influential businessmen, 2022. Birth year given as 1983 in some sources.

Name: Beket Izbastin
Current_Role: General Director, Chairman of the Management Board
Notes: Full name Beket (Bekzhet) Temirtayevich Izbastin. Degrees in international relations and oil and gas engineering; candidate of economic sciences. Order Kurmet. PSA LLP is the state's authorised body for the North Caspian (Kashagan), Karachaganak and Dunga production-sharing agreements.

Name: Nurassyl Medeu
Current_Role: Founder, Kazakh National Sports University; founder, AI National Research University (QAIRU)
Notes: Son of Dana Medeuova. BSc computer science, Boston University, 2020-2024.
